query: I have a 70‑year‑old female with acute pancreatitis. Among female inpatients 65–75 with acute pancreatitis, stratify first‑48‑hour lab instability scores into quintiles and report count, mean instability, mean LOS, mortality per quintile, and % with critical labs versus age‑matched inpatients.
final_sql:
WITH PatientDiagnosis AS (
  SELECT
    p.subject_id,
    p.gender,
    p.anchor_age AS age,
    d.icd_code
  FROM
    `physionet-data.mimiciv_3_1_hosp.patients` AS p
  INNER JOIN
    `physionet-data.mimiciv_3_1_hosp.diagnoses_icd` AS d
    ON p.subject_id = d.subject_id
  WHERE
    d.icd_code = 'K85' -- ICD-10 code for acute pancreatitis
    AND d.icd_version = 10
    AND p.gender = 'F'
    AND p.anchor_age BETWEEN 65 AND 75
), PatientICU AS (
  SELECT
    p.subject_id,
    i.hadm_id,
    i.stay_id,
    i.intime,
    i.outtime,
    i.los
  FROM
    PatientDiagnosis AS p
  INNER JOIN
    `physionet-data.mimiciv_3_1_icu.icustays` AS i
    ON p.subject_id = i.subject_id
), LabEvents AS (
  SELECT
    p.subject_id,
    p.hadm_id,
    p.stay_id,
    p.charttime,
    p.valuenum,
    p.valueuom,
    p.itemid
  FROM
    PatientICU AS p
  INNER JOIN
    `physionet-data.mimiciv_3_1_icu.chartevents` AS c
    ON p.subject_id = c.subject_id
    AND p.hadm_id = c.hadm_id
    AND p.stay_id = c.stay_id
  WHERE
    c.itemid IN (50912, 50911, 50910, 50909, 50913, 50914, 50915, 50916, 50917, 50918, 50919, 50920, 50921, 50922, 50923, 50924, 50925, 50926, 50927, 50928, 50929, 50930, 50931, 50932, 50933, 50934, 50935, 50936, 50937, 50938, 50939, 50940, 50941, 50942, 50943, 50944, 50945, 50946, 50947, 50948, 50949, 50950, 50951, 50952, 50953, 50954, 50955, 50;
